identity.name: LDAP Traffic from Non-Standard Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a non-standard Windows process to initiate LDAP traffic, bypassing normal detection. Cortex should detect this behavior as a deviation from expected process-to-LDAP traffic patterns.

biocs.name: LDAP traffic from non-standard process
biocs.description: Detects LDAP traffic initiated by a process not typically associated with LDAP operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 389
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'dllhost.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.10'

abiocs.name: Non-standard LDAP process behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a non-standard process initiates LDAP traffic
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 389
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'dllhost.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect LDAP traffic from non-standard process
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 389
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'dllhost.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name
